brief:
Israel faces a critical phase as a power struggle between Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and former military chief Gadi Eisenkot intensifies, Shehab Wire reported. The conflict has raised concerns that military escalation may be weaponized for political gain, destabilizing the government at a sensitive moment.

Deep divisions within Israeli leadership have emerged over strategic decisions and governance priorities. Observers warn that political infighting could compromise security decisions and complicate Israel's military operations.

title: Netanyahu and Eisenkot power struggle imperils Israeli stability
